items.title: Prime Minister Shah to highlight Nepal’s outsized climate burden at UN
items.blurb: Following devastating Bhotekoshi floods, Shah will press for financial support to help Nepal recover and build climate resilience.

items.title: Water starts flowing through landslide-dammed Hunga Khola, easing flood risk
items.blurb: Authorities had warned of possible flooding downstream after a landslide blocked the river in Solukhumbu and formed a roughly 100-metre-long dam on Friday morning.

items.title: Nepal estimates Rs2.34 billion to rebuild flood-hit education sector
items.blurb: Eighteen schools were affected in Rasuwa, disrupting classes for more than 9,000 students after the August 26 Bhotekoshi floods.

items.title: Nepal prepares Krishnabhir bypass as temporary fix remains uncertain
items.blurb: Officials are upgrading a 12-km road along the opposite bank of the Trishuli river as the landslide-prone Krishnabhir section of the Prithvi Highway remains closed.

items.title: PM Shah, New Zealand counterpart Luxon discuss flood response
items.blurb: Prime Minister Balendra Shah thanked New Zealand for NZ$2 million in humanitarian assistance and sought its support for climate-related loss and damage financing.

items.title: Landslide dams Solukhumbu river, spurring downstream flood warnings
items.blurb: Water spills over temporary blockade on Hunga Khola, but authorities urge riverside communities to stay clear as burst risk remains high.

items.title: For people with disabilities, surviving Nepal’s floods was only the beginning
items.blurb: From finding a safe route out to getting a wheelchair or a place in a shelter, survivors face barriers long after the waters recede.

items.title: Lessons from Nepal’s past for families living without answers
items.blurb: Physical closure may never come for those lost in the flood. But by walking hand-in-hand with survivors, we can provide the resources and empathy needed to navigate the uncertainty.

items.title: How the melting glaciers are unlocking ancient superbugs we’ve never seen before
items.blurb: Researchers warn that long-dormant pathogens and ancient antibiotic-resistance genes are slipping into freshwater systems.

items.title: A helicopter finally reaches flood-isolated Tiru of Rasuwa, 15 days after the devastating deluge
items.blurb: With all roads and bridges washed away by the catastrophic August 26 floods, the village has been effectively cut off from the outside world.

items.title: Rapid assessment puts Bhotekoshi recovery needs at Rs723 billion
items.blurb: Three-quarters of the bill is tied to infrastructure, with hydropower, roads, homes, and essential services among the hardest hit.

items.title: Climate loss and damage fund moves to consider urgent support for Nepal
items.blurb: FRLD co-chairs say they are working with the Board to respond to Kathmandu’s request following the August 26 Bhotekoshi floods.

items.title: Germany provides €8 million in assistance to Nepal after Bhotekoshi floods
items.blurb: The package includes emergency relief, humanitarian aid and development support for health, energy and disaster-resilient infrastructure.
